These findings collectively imply that 8-azaguanine may exert its effects on Hepatocyte through a cascade of molecular interactions involving potassium channels and other compounds. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which 8-azaguanine influences cellular function in Hepatocyte, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
